# Supplementary Assessment Documents

This page links to the supplementary architecture and project inventory documents included with this assessment. The scoped workspace contains Service Fabric deployment artifacts; the API, data model, and business workflow entries record where application source was not available.

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | Service Fabric deployment topology and component relationships inferred from the manifests. |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Declared NuGet build dependencies across the scoped deployment projects. |
| [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | API endpoint inventory result; no endpoint source was found in the scoped workspace. |
| [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) | Data access and entity model result; no application persistence implementation was found in scope. |
| [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Deployment configuration sources, profiles, parameters, and masked sensitive settings. |
| [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Business workflow analysis result; no business logic source was found in the scoped workspace. |
